name: Remote
description: Global HR platform for distributed teams. Monitor employee records.

config.setupInstructions:
You must be a company admin or company owner in Remote to generate API tokens.

1. Log in to Remote at https://remote.com
2. Navigate to: Company > Company Settings > Integrations & APIs > Integrations
3. Find the Remote API card and click it
4. Click Generate API token (or Create new token)
5. Under Endpoint collections, select "Read only"
   ("Read only" is sufficient — Comp AI does not modify your Remote data)
6. Click Generate, then copy the token (it starts with ra_live_)
7. Paste the token below
